Settling in Northamptonshire under severe financial strain, they faced the daunting reality of rebuilding from absolute zero.

Today, Imperial Age is reborn as a UK-based powerhouse. They’ve assembled a premier new lineup, opened a London fulfillment office to meet massive merch demand, completed their biggest European tour, and secured major 2026 festival slots, including the Bloodstock main stage.
